title: Zara dethrones Nike and crowns itself the world's most valuable fashion brand - Diari ARA
India’s textile reset is here. The winners will be built, not picked.
content:
India’s textile sector is entering an execution-led phase, with Warangal PM MITRA Park, UKITMC and CETA aligning capacity, technology and market access. 
Duty-free UK access can improve competitiveness, but only if factories deliver scale, compliance, traceability and faster turnaround. 
Weak apparel output, cotton cost risks and import-duty pressure remain key constraints.

title: ICE cotton futures close higher on dry weather concerns in US
content:
ICE cotton futures closed higher on persistent dry weather concerns in key US growing regions, especially Texas, which supported speculative buying.
Strong crude oil prices and expectations of improved Chinese demand also boosted sentiment.
July 2026 cotton settled at 86.81 cents per pound, the strongest close since April 2024, while traders maintained cautious bullish positions.

title: Vietnam’s index of industrial production up 9.9% YoY in April 2026
content:
Vietnam’s index of industrial production (IIP) rose by 3 per cent month on month and 9.9 per cent YoY in April, indicating strong growth momentum.
In January-April, the IIP rose by 9.2 per cent YoY, signalling a stable and broad-based recovery.
Manufacturing and processing served as the key growth engine, growing by 9.9 per cent YoY during the period and contributing 7.8 pps to overall industrial growth.
